brief:
Mondoweiss reported that the midterm elections have altered the political landscape regarding Israel and Iran policy, according to activist commentary on post-election strategy. The piece calls for pressure on Congress to end military involvement and support Palestinian rights as the Democratic Party recalibrates its foreign policy agenda.

Advocates cited in the analysis argue that momentum from the electoral shift should translate into legislative action on Middle East policy priorities. They outlined specific positions Congress should adopt, though implementation remains dependent on whether Democratic lawmakers respond to constituent pressure in the coming session.
dek: The midterm elections showed that the political landscape has shifted dramatically on Israel and the war in Iran. Now, activists must pressure Congress to end the war and support Palestinian rights. Here is what they should advocate for.
title: Activists push Democrats to shift stance on Israel policy after midterms
